articles.title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
articles.snippet: Quant jumped 39% over 24 hours and 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents rose, with the altcoin season index at its highest in more than three months.

articles.title: IBIT options price trading more calmly after Bitcoin rebound
articles.snippet: IBIT’s expected volatility sits near the bottom of its 12-month range, according to Saxo Bank’s analysis of options data from Sept. 23.

articles.title: Bitcoin price steadies, ONDO rallies as US Treasury yields hit 2007 highs
articles.snippet: US Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on Thursday, pressuring risk assets as Bitcoin held near $84,000 and ONDO became top performer among altcoins.

articles.title: OpenAI Is Building a $500 per Month ChatGPT Pro Max Plan, Leaks Suggest
articles.snippet: Leaked code strings and screenshots point to a new tier that would cost 25 times more than ChatGPT Plus, aimed at people who need the bot to work faster, not just longer.

articles.title: Bitcoin Breakout Cools as Fed Rate-Hike Bets Climb
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has slipped back below $85,000 after tagging an eight-month high near $87,400 last week, with rising odds of an October Fed hike taking some air out of the rally.
